name: Philo of Byblus
bio: Philo of Byblus is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors dates the poet to the 1st century AD (?). Paton's index describes him as of Byblus.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 419.

poems.title: Book XI, 419
poems.author: Philo of Byblus
poems.text: Grey hairs are more venerable together with good sense, for when they are not accompanied by sense they are rather a reproach to advanced age.
